description: Upload a local JSONL file to the Files API. purpose "fine-tune" for training/validation data (OpenAI chat format; DPO preference rows for DPO), "batch" for a batch input file (one request per line). At most 200 MB. Returns the file object; use its id in create_fine_tune, create_batch or an eval run. Free: no charge. Stored files count toward your storage limits.

path.description: Local path of the JSONL file to upload.

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file
